sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
sections.summary: Electrical infrastructure lacks documented clearances to buildings and structures; underground utility separation and transformer specifications are incomplete.

sections.label: Street Trees & Landscaping
sections.summary: Landscape plan lacks species identification and required clearance dimensions to electrical infrastructure; Austin Energy approval for restricted-clearance plantings is missing.

comments.headline: Missing horizontal clearance dimensions and surveyed conductor locations
comments.summary: Site plan and building elevations lack dimension annotations from building faces and projections to overhead electric conductors. No surveyed conductor locations or elevations provided to verify minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances required by code.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — registered surveyor field documentation of conductor locations and elevations required
comments.attn: All buildings and site features within clearance distance require verified conductor positions before approval

details.text: No horizontal clearance dimensions between building faces and overhead conductors. Surveyed conductor locations and elevation data not provided to verify 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance for Buildings 1-8 within potential clearance distance.

runComments.comment: No horizontal clearance dimensions shown between building faces and overhead electric conductors. No surveyed conductor locations or elevation data provided to verify that 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.

comments.headline: Missing vertical clearance verification for driveways and parking
comments.summary: No vertical clearance dimensions provided from driveway and parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Mid-span conductor sag data and minimum clearance verification (16-18 feet) missing for Type III driveway crossings.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — conductor elevation and mid-span sag measurements required
comments.attn: Type III driveways crossing overhead lines require registered surveyor mid-span clearance field measurements. Clearance appears potentially marginal based on site grading plan.

details.text: No vertical clearance dimensions from driveway and parking finished grades to lowest overhead conductor point. Mid-span conductor sag survey data not provided. Minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance cannot be verified. Two Type III driveways cross overhead line without documentation.

runComments.comment: No vertical clearance dimensions shown from driveway/parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Mid-span survey data for overhead conductor sag not provided. Minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance cannot be verified.

Two Type III driveways at site entries/exits cross the overhead electric line. No vertical clearance dimensions are shown on site plan or grading plan. No survey data from registered surveyor documenting mid-span clearances is provided. Compliance with 18-foot minimum vertical clearance (for areas with truck traffic) cannot be verified without detailed clearance survey.

Overhead electric lines confirmed on site. Grading plan and site plan show driveway alignments and finished floor/grade elevations but no section views or dimension annotations provided showing minimum vertical clearance (16-foot for parking without truck traffic, 18-foot for areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities to driveway surface.

details.text: If parking areas are located beneath overhead lines, no section views or clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum vertical clearance (16-18 feet) from lowest overhead facilities to parking surface. No note addressing clearance requirement.

runComments.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed on southern boundary. If parking areas are located beneath overhead lines, no section views or clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum vertical clearance (16-18 feet) from lowest overhead lines to parking surface, and no note addressing clearance requirement.

comments.headline: Missing registered surveyor documentation of utility pole and conductor data

comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — surveyor field data collection and certification of pole/conductor locations
comments.attn: Marginal vertical clearances identified; mid-span sag measurements essential for driveway and parking verification. Electric utility down guy anchors frequently omitted from standard surveys.

details.text: No registered surveyor survey data documenting overhead electric pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearance measurements. Vertical clearances from driveways, parking, and grades appear potentially marginal based on plan geometry. Mid-span clearance verification required when clearance compliance not self-evident.

runComments.comment: No registered surveyor survey data provided showing overhead electric pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearance measurements. Vertical clearances from proposed driveways, parking areas, and grades to overhead facilities cannot be verified from submitted plans.

Vertical clearance from overhead electric line to driveway grades and building elevations appears potentially marginal based on plan geometry. Registered surveyor survey data documenting pole locations, conductor elevations, and mid-span clearances is not provided. Mid-span clearance verification is required when vertical clearance compliance is not self-evident.

Overhead electric lines confirmed present along southern boundary near buildings and driveways. Based on site elevation data and estimated overhead line heights, vertical clearances appear marginal. No registered surveyor survey data provided showing measured pole locations and mid-span clearances to verify proposed site features maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground, 16-foot (parking), or 18-foot (truck traffic) vertical clearances.

details.text: Overhead utility poles present on existing survey (Sheet 4). Down guy wire anchor locations not called out on site plan. comments.headline: Missing clearance dimensions to transformer pads

comments.attn: Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) specifications required for window/door/vent clearance verification. Stairwell and dumpster locations not identified on site plan.

The four transformer pads appear to be located in close proximity to buildings per the site layout, but the required 5-foot clearance from buildings cannot be verified. Specific dimensions from the outside edge of each transformer pad to all adjacent building foundations and structures must be dimensioned on the plan.

comments.headline: Transformer pad specifications and dimensions not provided

comments.attn: Pad dimensions (e.g., 6'x6', 10'x10') and service type specification essential for compliance verification. kVA rating and equipment type (single-phase vs. three-phase) required. Reference to approved Austin Energy Design detail sheets must be provided.

No pad dimensions (length, width, depth) are provided, and no references to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included. The service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not specified. Pad dimensions must match AE Design specifications and be clearly dimensioned on the plan or referenced to approved AE Design details.

Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans with zero dimension specifications.
